notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware run. The device is a simulated world.sim at R0: no hardware backend and no physical effect. The card's preferred upstream-sim path (gym.make('iCubReach-v0')) needs Gym, PyBullet and the object-model data and was not run; fake.py is this package's pure Python stand-in for the legacy Gym iCubReachGymEnv (reset(), step(action) returning the four-tuple, seed(seed)) and was not compared with the upstream environment. The fake keeps the upstream 31-element observation shape but fills the orientation, velocity, joint, object-orientation and relative-orientation channels with zeros; its start jitter and object pose are placeholders and never facts or limits. Warnings, all expected of the Gymnasium family bridge and not cleared: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the pending seed of the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT (the bridge-derived seed twice, ticks and action.values). G4 had no warnings. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest the last run printed.
